name: 2 Disney Games: Phineas and Ferb + Phineas and Ferb Ride Again
summary: Join Phineas and Ferb on their wild afternoon adventures! Explore the neighbourhood in search of useful materials, build incredible inventions and stop Candace from ratting you out to Mum. You can also hit the track in some crazy vehicles for some hair-raising races and take control of Agent P to foil Dr Doofenshmirtz’s evil plans!
